svg.title: Alignment concatenation
svg.desc: locus_1 has 10 sites and locus_2 has 8 sites for samples seq1 to seq3. Concatenation joins each sample's sequences into one 18-site alignment, with locus_1 at sites 1 to 10 and locus_2 at sites 11 to 18, and writes the partition in RAxML or NEXUS format.
svg.text: Plus a partition file in the format you choose:
